note: _in quo mundabo cor tuum_ – wherein shall I cleanse thy heart (Douay Version). Jerome’s translation is based on Symmachus. – Friedrich Stummer: _‚amula_ (Ez xvi 30A). _Vetus Testamentum_ 4 (1954) 34–40, at p. 35.
_iustificatae sunt enim a te_ – they are more justified than you (echoing Hebrew _min_). In standard Latin, this would be: _sunt magis iustae quam tu_. – Kaulen, p. 237.
